name: Grace Lutheran Church Tucson

sources.label: Grace Lutheran Church - Tucson campus page

notes: Lutheran congregation in the University of Arizona area, in existence since 1911. Search snippet says the church publishes both service videos and printed sermon manuscripts - printed manuscripts are unusually good source material for a text-similarity review, so this one is worth prioritising. Synod affiliation (ELCA vs LCMS vs other) was not confirmed; the site domain covers more than one campus, so check whether Tucson has its own preaching pastor.
